model_annotation: This donut chart, titled “Stimuli Type,” visually represents the distribution of 38 stimuli categorized by type, with each slice labeled with its count out of 38. The chart contains seven distinct segments, each with a unique color and corresponding label. The largest segment, colored dark green, represents “External News Article (15/38),” accounting for approximately 39% of the total. Following this is the red segment for “Draft/Other (9/38),” which makes up about 24%. The “Email (5/38)” category is shown in a dark red/brown color, representing roughly 13%. The “External News Article” segment is the most prominent, followed by “Draft/Other,” then “Email.” Two smaller segments, “Organizational Report (2/38)” and “Interview (2/38),” are both colored purple and navy blue respectively and each represent about 5%. The smallest segment, “Intra-agency news article (1/38),” is a small orange slice, representing roughly 3%. The “Press Release (4/38)” category is shown as a yellow slice, accounting for approximately 11%. All labels are positioned externally around the chart, and the chart includes a central title “Stimuli Type.” There is no legend, and no slices are visually emphasized or exploded. The segments appear to be ordered in descending size around the chart.
